description_en: Call the SaveBatchTaskForReserveDropListDomain API to submit a batch task for domain reservation
description_zh: 调用SaveBatchTaskForReserveDropListDomain提交批量万网域名预定任务
kebab_example: aliyun domain save-batch-task-for-reserve-drop-list-domain --contact-template-id 123123 --domains DomainName=example.com Dns1=ns11.bigwww.com Dns2=nsb.263idc.net --api-version 2018-01-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SaveBatchTaskForReserveDropListDomain

fields.help_en:
The first custom DNS server.

This parameter is required only if you set AliyunDns to false.

Make sure that your custom DNS servers are valid. Otherwise, the domain reservation may fail
fields.help_zh:
自定义DNS1。

当OrderActivateParam.N.AliyunDns取值为false时，本参数才可用且必须传入。
请务必确保自定义DNS的正确性，否则可能导致注册失败
